verdict.rationale: Algolia is a hosted SaaS that processes customer data with AI features (NeuralSearch, ML-based Recommend, Agent Studio), so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no data-usage policy, no AI-training opt-out, and no contractual commitment that customer data is excluded from model training. The Agent Studio completion-caching note concerns cost, not training use.
